title: Force Push Confirm
summary: Lists every commit a force push would drop, marks other people's work and builds a safer lease command, so teammates' commits aren't erased.
description: Lists every commit a force push would drop with author, message and age, marks other people's commits and protected branches, builds a --force-with-lease command pinned to the tip shown (or --force-if-includes), and asks you to type the branch name.
catches: Commits on the remote that the push would drop
Commits by other people, including co-authors and GitHub noreply addresses
A remote tip that moved since you looked
limits: Uses the commit lists you pass; it doesn't run git
--force-with-lease only protects the tip you pinned; your Git host's branch protection is the real guard
a11y: Dropped commits are a labelled list
The lease option is a labelled checkbox; branch confirmation is a typed field
server: Protect shared branches in your Git host (no force pushes, required reviews); this dialog only prepares a safer command.
stops: Teammates' commits erased by force push
